component.name: Mikoshi
component.summary: Back up and restore your Arch Linux system

description.p: Mikoshi makes rsync snapshot backups of your system settings, dotfiles, app settings, desktop, packages, home folders or the whole system, to a second drive, a USB drive or an NFS share. Every snapshot is a normal folder you can browse, and unchanged files are shared between snapshots so they take no extra space.
Schedule backups, run them before every pacman upgrade or when a drive is plugged in, keep as many as you like, and restore single files or whole folders with a preview first.
